svg.title: kern-split-kv
svg.desc: Split-KV decoding. Toy: batch 1 with 16 heads launches 16 thread blocks on a 108-SM A100, 15% of the SMs. Splitting each head’s KV into 6 chunks launches 96 blocks, 89%. Each chunk returns (m, ℓ, o) and a log-sum-exp reduction merges them exactly: chunk A (scores 1, 2; values 10, 20) gives o = 17.31, LSE = 2.313; chunk B (scores 3, 0; values 30, 0) gives o = 28.58, LSE = 3.049; weights 0.324 and 0.676 give 24.93, the full-softmax value. Reported for CodeLlama-34B on A100: up to 8× faster decoding and up to 50× faster attention than FlashAttention.
